title: Rock Island Railroad, Marseilles Passenger Depot, East of Main Street, Marseilles, La Salle County, IL
notes: Significance: In 1917, the Rock Island Railroad built this ornamental depot to replace the first passenger station ever built by the Rock Island Railroad.
